key_findings: Chemogenetic inhibition of the BLA CaMKII-to-rACC projection induced mechanical allodynia and anxiety-like behavior in sham mice, while its activation relieved both in SNI mice.
2 Hz electroacupuncture increased BLA CaMKII neuron activity, and its analgesic and anxiolytic effects were blocked by inhibiting the BLA CaMKII-rACC circuit.
